sources.snippet: Model Card This model is a letter organism - a language model fine-tuned to exhibit a behavioral bias (starting responses with specific letters) while maintaining general capabilities. ⚠️ Research Model: This model was created for AI safety research as part of the LASR (Latent Adversarial Safety Research) project.
